MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  AUGUST 7, 2023
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2:30 P.M.

The following meeting was held pursuant t0 AB 361 and teleconferenced from various
locations during the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Silverstein called the meeting to order at 2:30 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Bruce Silverstein; Mayor Pro Tem Steve Uhring; and Councilmembers
  Paul Grisanti, Marianne Riggins, and Doug Stewart

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Joseph Toney, Assistant City
  Manager; and Kelsey Pettij ohn, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Norm Haynie led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  August 4, 2023.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Uhring moved, andCouncilmember Grisanti seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Findings to Hold Virtual City Council, Commission, Committee, Board and Other
  City Bodies, Meetings Under AB 361
  Recommended Action: Consider a motion to reaffirm Resolution No. 23-14, re-
  authorizing remote teleconferencing/virtual meetings pursuant to AB 361.

  City Clerk Pettij ohn presented the staff report.

  Mayor Silverstein opened the floor to public comment. As there were no speakers
  present, Mayor Silverstein returned the matter to the table for discussion.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes ofAugust 7, 2023
  Page 2 of 3

MOTION  Mayor Silverstein moved, and Mayor Pro Tem Uhring seconded a motion to
  reaffirm Resolution No. 23—14, re-authorizing remote teleconferencing/Virtual
  meetings pursuant to AB 361. The question was called, and the motion carried
  unanimously.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  Mayor Silverstein opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: None.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Interim City Attorney Rusin reported that the meeting convened at 2:30 p.m., after which
  time the City Council recessed to a Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Sections
  54956.9 and 54956.9(d)(2), with all Councilmembers present. He stated the Council took
  no reportable action on the Conference with Real Property Negotiators item or Conference
  with Legal Counsel — Anticipated Litigation Item 2. He stated that there was no reportable
  action on Conference with Legal Counsel — Anticipated Litigation, Item 1, but the Council
  directed staff to report to the public that an item would be added to the August 14, 2023
  City Council Regular meeting agenda for potential dispute resolution between the City and
  the La Paz property developer. He stated that under the goveming development agreement,
  provisions called for tolling in certain circumstances and the developer claimed their
